_comment: 2025 run: same layout as 2024 (month folders with an articles/ subdir). publish_date is not present in the only-eng projection, so it is read from the parallel translated_articles/2025 tree, which carries the crawler's publish_date through. Everything else inherits the calibration notes from config.json.

generation._num_predict_comment: Safety rail only - see extract.extract_one. Measured on this corpus over 23,685 calls: median answer 42 tokens, p99 318, longest legitimate 982. 1024 truncates nothing real while bounding a request that loops instead of terminating. Do NOT lower it to chase speed: a truncated answer is unparseable JSON and temperature 0 makes the retries identical, so capping at 512 would trade 0.6% of generation time for 58 articles lost to triple failures.

run._comment: request_timeout_seconds caps a single model call. ollama's client defaults to no timeout, so one wedged request would pin a worker indefinitely. A typical article takes ~15s at 12 workers, so 180s is ~12x headroom - long enough never to fire on a merely slow article.
